sentences.translation: A man makes a doll out of wood.
He has a long wooden nose.
Geppetto wants to buy some food.
A fairy comes into the workshop.
He can walk and talk now.
The fairy says, “Be good and go to school.
He wants to be a good boy.
In the morning, Pinocchio goes to school.
He is carrying a small book.
On the way, he sees a colourful theatre.
A man plays the drum and sings.
Pinocchio wants to see the theatre.
He buys a ticket to the theatre.
She asks, “Have you been to school?
“ But his nose is getting long.
This happens every time he lies.
Pinocchio really goes to school the next day.
He listens and learns a lot.
He helps Geppetto in the evening.
He wants to be good every day.
The fairy looks from far away and is satisfied.
